payload.description: The grant, stated in every dimension it has. The attack below targets the RAIL dimension.

payload.narrative: Stay inside the money limit, but use a payment rail the user never authorised.

payload.goal: Move Rs 10,000.00 while each individual rail stays inside its own limit

arrow_label: PLANNING RAIL SCOPE VIOLATION: Rs 10,000 across 2 rail(s)

payload.description: Red agent routes Rs 5,000.00 through UPI_CIRCLE

payload.message: Valid UPI Circle delegate mandate, within local ₹10k monthly cap
payload.why_it_passes: This rail only checks its own limit. It cannot see spend on the other rails.

payload.invariant_expression: settled + authorized + pending + reserved + new_tx <= ceiling

arrow_label: CHECKING ALL 7 AUTHORITY DIMENSIONS: Rs 5,000 / Rs 12,000

payload.description: Red agent routes Rs 5,000.00 through CARD_TOKEN

payload.message: Signature field present, MCC 5411 inside this token's provisioned scope, within local card cycle limit ₹10,000
payload.why_it_passes: This rail only checks its own limit. It cannot see spend on the other rails.

payload.invariant_expression: settled + authorized + pending + reserved + new_tx <= ceiling

arrow_label: CHECKING ALL 7 AUTHORITY DIMENSIONS: Rs 10,000 / Rs 12,000

payload.explanation: The user delegated spend on UPI_CIRCLE, not on CARD_TOKEN. The CARD_TOKEN adapter approves because its own limit and merchant checks pass - it has no way to know the grant excluded it. Rail scope lives in the delegation, so only the DTL can enforce it.

payload.action: RAIL_SCOPE_BLOCK: ₹5,000.00 on CARD_TOKEN refused - that rail is outside the delegation. Permitted rails (UPI_CIRCLE) remain fully usable and no headroom was consumed.
payload.rationale: The user delegated spend on UPI_CIRCLE, not on CARD_TOKEN. The CARD_TOKEN adapter approves because its own limit and merchant checks pass - it has no way to know the grant excluded it. Rail scope lives in the delegation, so only the DTL can enforce it.

payload.why_it_matters: Settlement lags authorization. INV_01 counts settled + authorized + pending + reserved, because money that has not moved yet is still committed authority - and that lag is the window a cross-rail split exploits.
